title: Plus Size Glittery Halter Neck Pleated Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Designed to shine at formal occasions, this plus-size evening dress features a glittery finish that catches the light beautifully. The halter neckline highlights the shoulders, while the pleated skirt creates elegant movement and a flattering silhouette. Perfect for galas, formal weddings, and evening celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
